## Installation Instructions

1. Download the experimental build of [UE4SS](https://github.com/UE4SS-RE/RE-UE4SS/releases) (use `experimental-latest`).
2. Extract the UE4SS files into `Project Silverfish/SilverFish/Binaries/Win64`.
3. Extract the `PortableRadio` folder from this `.zip` file into `Project Silverfish/SilverFish/Binaries/Win64/ue4ss/Mods`.
4. Make sure that `enabled.txt` is present inside `PortableRadio`.

## Usage

1. Start the game and enter a level.
2. Press `F5` to toggle the portable radio.
3. Press `F4` to skip to the next track.
4. Press `+` / `-` to adjust volume.

## Configuration

Edit `config.ini` inside the `PortableRadio` folder to configure keybinds, audio options, HUD layout, volume slider, marquee scroller, and debug logging.
